title: Sequence and supercoiling-dependent effects on the structural dynamics of DNA minicircles.
authors: Micheloni, Manuel; Tubiana, Luca; Potestio, Raffaello; Petrolli, Lorenzo
one_liner_zh: 该文用粗粒化MD模拟研究DNA微环的序列与超螺旋密度对结构动力学及变性泡形成的影响，虽涉及DNA构象动态与转录因子识别相关的局部缺陷，但未直接聚焦TF-DNA结合或互作建模，方法可迁移至蛋白-DNA互作研究。
abstract: The degree of over-/underwinding of the DNA double helix, quantified by the superhelical density, is a key feature modulating critical biological processes such as gene expression and regulation. In fact, DNA molecules are able to channel the excess levels of mechanical stress into local defective and denatured states that are promptly detected by, e.g., transcription factors and nuclease enzymes. The occurrence and stability of these motifs are dictated by a complex interplay between topological and sequence-dependent effects, ultimately affecting the global conformational dynamics of the DNA molecule itself. Here, we characterize the impact of the sequence and of the superhelical density on the structural evolution of a 672-bp DNA minicircle via classical molecular dynamics simulations employing the coarse-grained oxDNA force field. We observe that moderately-to-highly undercoiled regimes are associated with the occurrence of stable, somewhat broad denaturation bubbles, typically co-localizing with flexible nucleotide sequences on the DNA minicircle. These defects are hardly reabsorbed by the system, thereby pinning the subsequent dynamics of the molecule. In fact, a similar behavior was recapitulated by enforcing "synthetic,"adjoining DNA mismatches, regardless of the underlying nucleotide sequence, suggesting an effective manner of DNA manipulation.
abstract_zh: DNA双螺旋的过度/不足缠绕程度，通过超螺旋密度量化，是调节基因表达与调控等关键生物过程的一个核心特征。实际上，DNA分子能够将过量的机械应力引导至局部缺陷和变性状态，这些状态可被例如转录因子和核酸酶迅速检测到。这些基序的出现和稳定性由拓扑效应与序列依赖性效应之间的复杂相互作用决定，最终影响DNA分子本身的整体构象动力学。在此，我们通过采用粗粒化oxDNA力场的经典分子动力学模拟，表征了序列和超螺旋密度对672-bp DNA微环结构演化的影响。我们观察到，中度至高度欠缠绕状态与稳定、略显宽泛的变性气泡的出现相关，这些气泡通常与DNA微环上的柔性核苷酸序列共定位。这些缺陷难以被系统重新吸收，从而固定了分子随后的动力学行为。实际上，通过强制引入“合成”的相邻DNA错配，无论底层核苷酸序列如何，均重现了类似行为，这提示了一种有效的DNA操控方式。
